title: Voxel Worlds
description: A voxel-based game currently in development at Zygobot Studios. Serving as Lead Engineer, driving architecture and technical direction for the project.

title: Performance Auditor
description: A Vulkan-based CI/CD GPU performance profiling tool for automated regression detection with zero game code changes. Intercepts GPU commands via a custom C++ Vulkan layer to track draw calls, VRAM allocations, GPU timestamps, and CPU-GPU fence sync, streaming telemetry via gRPC to a Go/TimescaleDB backend and React cloud dashboard.

title: Orrery-Sol
description: A fully self-contained, autonomous space-colony simulation built in Godot 4.7. Generates an entire galaxy from a seed—star systems, planets, ~450 colonies, and 10,000+ colonists—with 100% procedural art, synthesized audio, and grammar-driven chronicles running deterministically at 100× speed.

title: VS Mod Manager
description: A cross-platform desktop mod manager for Vintage Story built with C#, .NET 9, and Avalonia UI. Features ModDB browsing across 9,000+ mods, one-click updates with backup rollback, automatic dependency resolution, and profile management for Windows and Linux.

title: Roots
description: A cozy multiplayer farming simulation built in Godot 4.7 with Jolt Physics and GD-Sync. Features procedural Transvoxel smooth SDF terrain with SQLite persistence, 10 biomes, farming, 40+ crafting recipes, a 7-profession skill system, animal husbandry, AI combat, and village NPCs with quests.

title: Mid Evil Nights
description: Completed systems engineering work at Zygobot Studios including core gameplay mechanics, combat systems, and engine-level optimizations.

title: Cyber Rayne
description: A 2D cyberpunk JRPG built from scratch using modern C++ and a custom Vulkan renderer, featuring strategic turn-based combat, class-based character kits, and a custom UI framework.

title: ActionRPG: Project Overpowered
description: An Action RPG developed in Godot 4.4 inspired by Path of Exile and Torchlight Infinite. Start from nothing and engineer an overpowered robot across 5 starting classes in the post-human ruins of civilization.

title: Squid Bubbles
description: A charming underwater exploration game where you discover and learn about marine life.

title: Iron Reclamation
description: A first / third person action game developed in Unreal Engine 5 and C++, featuring responsive combat and custom character assets.
